promptingStudio.scene: An underground research outpost or quiet broadcast acoustics booth. Dry, close proximity effect with zero room reflections, giving an intimate sense of being deep subterranean.
promptingStudio.sampleContext: Atmospheric, hushed, awe-inspiring, and slightly eerie. Deliberate measured pacing with deep chest resonance, emphasizing the isolation of deep cave exploration.
promptingStudio.sampleSpeechBlock: They set up underground camps at depths where no sunlight has reached in millions of years. They squeezed through passages so narrow that they had to exhale completely to fit their rib cages through the rock. At 2,212 m below the surface, deeper than six Empire State buildings stacked on top of each other, they found a river. It was flowing. They could hear it in the darkness before they saw it. Nobody knows where it goes. In another cave in the Mexican desert, crystals taller than a fourstory building grow in a chamber where the air temperature is 58° C and the humidity is 99%. A human being without protective equipment loses consciousness in roughly 10 minutes.

Sample Context: Atmospheric, hushed, awe-inspiring, and slightly eerie. Deliberate measured pacing with deep chest resonance, emphasizing the isolation of deep cave exploration.

Speaker 1 - Subterranean Explorer (Marcus / Callum):
They set up underground camps at depths where no sunlight has reached in millions of years. They squeezed through passages so narrow that they had to exhale completely to fit their rib cages through the rock. At 2,212 m below the surface, deeper than six Empire State buildings stacked on top of each other, they found a river. It was flowing. They could hear it in the darkness before they saw it. Nobody knows where it goes. In another cave in the Mexican desert, crystals taller than a fourstory building grow in a chamber where the air temperature is 58° C and the humidity is 99%. A human being without protective equipment loses consciousness in roughly 10 minutes.
